name: LinkStack
description: Your own link-in-bio page with all your links in one place

paths.name: Htdocs
paths.description: The whole LinkStack app with its SQLite database, settings, themes and uploads. It is copied in on first start. Back it up.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: LinkStack pages and admin panel, published on host as 6776

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: SERVER_ADMIN
variables.description: Your email, shown on the web server's error pages.

variables.name: UPLOAD_MAX_FILESIZE
variables.description: The biggest file you can upload (profile pictures, themes), like 8M or 32M.
